Long afternoon window light rakes across the wool nap, raised braid, sash folds, and cotton gaiters, with cooler hall light filling her face. The brass corners and pale tissue lining of the open trunk echo the warm light. She glances toward the camera with quiet confidence and a softly relaxed mouth.
